settings.title: First full night in years
settings.text: I've had restless legs since my second pregnancy. I was skeptical, but the pressure under my arch just… switches it off. I slept through on night two.
settings.author: Linda R.

settings.title: My husband noticed before I did
settings.text: He said I stopped kicking him. That alone was worth it. Comfortable enough that I forget I'm wearing them.
settings.author: Maria G.

settings.title: Cheaper than the prescription one
settings.text: My doctor mentioned a pressure wrap that costs over $200. Found these instead. Same idea, and they actually work for me.
settings.author: Tom B.

settings.title: Takes a few nights to get the fit right
settings.text: First night I had them too loose. Once I tightened the strap so the pad really pressed into my arch, big difference. Recommend sizing up if you're between.
settings.author: Karen W.

settings.title: No more pacing the hallway
settings.text: I used to get up 3–4 times a night to walk it off. Now it's maybe once a week. I wish I'd found these sooner.
settings.author: James P.

settings.title: Great on long flights too
settings.text: Bought a second pair for travel. Wore them on a 9-hour flight and my legs stayed calm the whole way.
settings.author: Susan L.
